headline: LAD @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 4.58 at LAA 3.87, with a projected total of 8.45. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: LAD moved +0.17 runs while LAA moved +1.14, changing the projected margin by -0.98 runs. The projected total climbed +1.31, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -14.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Zach Neto, Nolan Schanuel, Teoscar Hernández, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Dalton Rushing, Sebastián Rivero because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
